summary: Official warnings note risks of severe allergic reactions, including sudden body-wide reactions called anaphylaxis and airway tightness called bronchospasm, which require stopping the drug and seeking care [3]. The label also warns against using ondansetron tablets in certain patients due to heart rhythm issues, such as QT interval prolongation and torsade de pointes [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated medium-risk scores of 63 for the liver and 56 for the heart [M].
